_: Kill-check for asc-09wx.8.6: `asc ingest file-changed`, the second observer of `asc-09wx.8`'s intervention ledger, plus the three places its `source` value is written. The mechanism is small and each of its claims is a separate decision, so the mutants are chosen one per decision rather than one per function: the source value itself landing in a sibling bucket (M10) -- the mistake the 'the suffix names the ascend subsystem, not the thing read' argument exists to prevent, and the one that would inflate nobody's count because entries are immutable; the id keyed on the EVENT rather than on the tool call it came from (M2), which is the difference between one row per edit and one row per MultiEdit; the watched set as the filter rather than as a formality (M7); `applied_at` omitted rather than fabricated when the event carried no timestamp (M8); `applied_at` never omitted at all (M6's sibling, M9's is `status`); `digest` absent because the event carries edit strings and not file bytes (M3) -- filling it by hashing the file at ingest time is the honest-looking version of the same defect, so the mutant plants exactly that; validation before the transaction rather than inside it (M5). M4 is the `--dry-run` arm, and it is here because the preview runs the REAL writers under a rollback: a cut that made the preview write would be invisible to any assertion about the counts it prints. The killers were found empirically rather than guessed: each mutant was applied, the owning suites were run with vitest's JSON reporter, and the failing names were read off its assertionResults -- never chosen from the test titles. M2 is worth one note: written as `event.id` it does not compile (`TS4111`, an index-signature property needs the bracket spelling), so it was respelled `event['id']` -- a mutant killed by `tsc` is a mutant the suite never reached, and the run's own beforeAll would have reported that as a failing test rather than as a dead mutant. M12 kills eleven of the thirteen tests, which is not redundancy: `observed:file-changed` missing from the store's CHECK constraint refuses every row of the run, and that breadth is the measurement of how much of this feature is one value.
